title: A study of Waymo robotaxi data for 13.8M trips from August 2023 to December 2025: the share of miles driven with a passenger onboard climbed from 36% to 56% (Jonathan M. Gitlin/Ars Technica)
summary: Jonathan M. Gitlin / Ars Technica: A study of Waymo robotaxi data for 13.8M trips from August 2023 to December 2025: the share of miles driven with a passenger onboard climbed from 36% to 56% — The age of robotaxis, long the preserve of science fiction, is now a reality, at least in a handful of American cities.
